objects.name: The Xcode Assassin Returns: A Deep Dive Into the Latest XCSSET Version
objects.description: Analysis of XCSSET v40 reveals a macOS malware targeting developers via Xcode. Unit 42 used advanced pattern matching and AI to decode its logic. The post The Xcode Assassin Returns: A Deep Dive Into the Latest XCSSET Version appeared first on Unit 42 .
